remote_function_state.details: Verified via user's manual SQL execution. Contains casual_customers, notification_outbox, premium bypass, etc.

db_push_safe.reason: db push will attempt to run ALL migrations from 0020 to 2026... because they are not recorded in remote schema_migrations. For 0041 (idempotent CREATE OR REPLACE) and 2026 (empty), this is perfectly safe. However, if the user has manually created tables from 0020-0040 on production, db push will crash with 'relation already exists'.

recommended_next_step: Verify if the schema changes from 0020 to 0040 were manually applied to production. If they were NOT manually applied (which our 404 check on casual_submissions suggests), then 'supabase db push' is the correct and safe way to deploy all pending migrations, including our perfected 0041.
